input: Find arts, crafts, music, theater and dance summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Waynesville, Canton, Clyde, Maggie Valley and Lake Junaluska, NC (Haywood County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Waynesville art music theater dance summer camp 2026 2025
Haywood Community College Bobcat College 2026 art

candidates.name: HART Theatre
candidates.note: Summer musical-theater production camps and a two-week triple-threat intensive for middle and high school students.

candidates.name: Waynesville Art School
candidates.note: Children’s summer art camps include painting, sculpture, crafts and themed creative projects; 2025 sessions documented.

candidates.name: MusicWorks! Studio of Performing Arts
candidates.note: 2026 half-day themed camps for ages 3–11 combine dance, music, theater and crafts.

candidates.name: Haywood County 4-H / N.C. Cooperative Extension
candidates.note: 2025 local summer programs included evening tie-dye, beginner and intermediate sewing day camps, cooking and STEM.

candidates.name: Haywood Community College
candidates.note: Bobcat College ran June 15–19, 2026, for rising grades 6–8, with creative arts among its hands-on activities.

candidates.name: Skyland Camp and Retreats
candidates.note: 2027 girls’ overnight sessions announced for rising grades 1–10; activities include recycled arts and musical theater.

candidates.name: The Fellowship of Worship Artists
candidates.note: June 22–26, 2026, Music & Worship Arts Week included elementary, middle and high school choirs and arts rehearsal groups.

candidates.name: Haywood County Public Library
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Reading Challenge offered youth programming; summer activities include in-person programs, performers and crafts.

candidates.name: Bethel Elementary School
candidates.note: Tuesday summer library sessions, June 16–August 4, 2026, combined stories, building, crafting and creative problem-solving.
